verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Tap to Pay on iPhone solution for accepting contactless in-person payments with the iPhone as the payment interface. Its marketing page says compatible smartphones or tablets become Tap to Pay checkouts with no extra hardware required, which covers the core of the story. The iOS docs sit under a 'build' path, which implies developer integration work rather than a ready-to-use app for a founder. Missing for 10: explicit Android/tablet documentation, evidence of a turnkey no-code setup for a founder, independent or hands-on corroboration.
